scenario.name: 1-3 continuous walking and repeated rotation with unified framing SHORT WORKLOAD PROBE (not performance acceptance)
scenario.entryRequirement: Fresh isolated context with --level 1-3. This is explicit-level diagnosis, not normal-home acceptance. No save edits or QA state restoration.
evidence: Native initial 1-3 x corridor ends on central garden; hold ArrowRight to its boundary instead of clicking stale screen coordinates.
scenario.validationStatus: Pending short real-input no-QA workload probe on bdc66a9c unified-framing build; full 29-second walking rounds are retained for final performance run.

phases.name: idle-initial
phases.expected: 1-3 western starting island; no overlay; both actors visible.

phases.name: walk-continuous-1
phases.expected: Short 3-second diagnostic: actual right/left corridor traversal. Final timing scenario retains 29 seconds per round.

phases.name: walk-continuous-2
phases.expected: Short 3-second diagnostic: actual right/left corridor traversal. Final timing scenario retains 29 seconds per round.

phases.name: walk-continuous-3
phases.expected: Short 3-second diagnostic: actual right/left corridor traversal. Final timing scenario retains 29 seconds per round.

phases.name: approach-turn-center
phases.expected: Walk right through the current z=0 corridor until its central-module boundary; support m:garden:0:0, handle within interaction range. Final approach may include intentional boundary wait, measured separately from continuous walking.

phases.name: turn-first
phases.expected: Actual turn:garden, garden 0 to 1; actors carried; northern bank connects.

phases.name: turn-repeat-to-2
phases.expected: Garden orientation 1 to 2, actors carried.

phases.name: turn-repeat-to-3
phases.expected: Garden orientation 2 to 3, actors carried.

phases.name: turn-repeat-to-0
phases.expected: Garden orientation 3 to 0, returning to starting geometry.

phases.name: turn-repeat-same-0-to-1
phases.expected: Repeat identical orientation 0 to 1 transition after full cycle, compare with turn-first.

phases.name: undo-latest-stable-state
phases.expected: Undo latest actual checkpoint. Follower settling may mean this restores pose in same orientation; inspect actual outcome and do not assume it reverses the garden.

phases.name: undo-next-stable-state
phases.expected: Second real undo; inspect actual platform and actor state, without assuming a fixed history depth.

phases.name: idle-after-actions
phases.expected: Actors supported and UI responsive after repeated turning/undo.

scope: Fresh isolated browser profile does not guarantee empty OS/driver caches. No QA publisher. CDP TaskDuration is renderer main-thread task time, not isolated Godot CPU or GPU duration. GL wrappers measure synchronous API latency and add overhead. First action and repeated action must both be present and visually verified. Collection completion is not a frame-budget or gameplay pass.
